comparisonScope.aggregate: Original summary fields, excluding revision, sourceUnchanged, medianMs and maxMs.
comparisonScope.detailed: Explicit behavior projections, compared as per-scenario trial multisets; iteration order has no semantic role.
comparisonScope.excluded: Timestamps/durations, random IDs, ephemeral local URL ports, opaque identity/retry hashes, passive quote values, full proof text, raw plans and events. Raw JSON remains authoritative; retained plan state counts and unknown-ID equality checks preserve multiplicity and cross-restart identity.
comparisonScope.retained: Oracle events, actual A/B/C input values, correspondence expectations/results, status/reasons, action purposes, unknown preservation/guards, necessary reentries, round/action/model budgets, all 100 price tick row counts.
comparisonScope.performance: Timings are retained in summary for provenance only; these trials do not establish storage or real-site performance.
